messages:
alex_support: FYI customer BrightMarket hitting sustained 503s and huge tail latency on their dedicated pool. They say we never spin up past min_replicas (set to 2). They see request queueing and timeouts.
rina_custsuccess: Customer reported impact after a deploy at ~09:12 UTC. They said calls started 429/503 and then many requests stayed pending for >30s. Customer has Dedicated Tier B commitment.
marta_oncall: @alex_support can you paste the root error/log sample? Also what autoscaler policy do they have (min/max, targetUtil)?
alex_support: paste of error from their app gateway: `upstream response timeout 30s` and our proxy logs show `503 backend_unavailable attach_request_denied`. From our dashboard: pool=dedicated-us-east-2, min=2, max=20, targetCPU=60. No recent quota changes on customer account.
jason_eng_platform: Two quick hypotheses: 1) attach/authz failing which prevents new warmpool attachments, 2) imagepull or node-provision throttles (registry IAM rotation/billing hold) causing delayed spin-up.
alex_support: Customer also said they saw `403 attach denied: service-account not found` for a handful of retries earlier.
marta_oncall: That 403 is interesting. @srebot can you surface any IAM rotation or recent key-roll events for the account?
srebot: Automated check: recent KMS rotation for BrightMarket service account at 08:55 UTC, 3 attach failures recorded between 09:10-09:15 UTC. No active billing hold returned by billing API.
jason_eng_platform: If attach fails while autoscaler thinks it has capacity, it may stop scaling further because pods are reported as pending/failed but min replica floor prevents additional logic. Repro suggestion: from a test cluster replicate attach rejection and send synthetic 200 RPS for 60s to trigger scale. Use header `X-Customer-ID: brightmarket` and check `attach_request` traces.
alex_support: Repro steps I gave customer: 1) curl -H "X-Customer-ID: brightmarket" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate - run at 80 RPS for 2m. They saw queue growth and no new pods beyond 2.
marta_oncall: Action plan: (A) assign eng-platform to check autoscaler decision logs between 09:10-09:20, (B) SRE to validate IAM sync & imagepull errors, (C) Support to keep customer on reduced QPS and enable fallback model variant. @jason_eng_platform can you take (A)?
jason_eng_platform: Taking (A). I'll pull autoscaler decision trace and the scale controller logs. Also will check if the scaler canceled scale due to repeated attach failures (policy to avoid thrash).
ops_bot: Created ticket INF-8762 assigned to eng-platform -> jason_eng_platform, severity=P2.
marta_oncall: I'll stay on this thread until we have a mitigation. If attach errors are authz, short-term mitigation is to fail open to a safe fallback (can we allow warmpool attach retry bypass for 5m?) Otherwise we may need manual warmpool preprovision.
alex_support: Customer accepted reduced traffic and turned on fallback. They're asking for root cause and ETA to fully restore scaling. I'll update ticket with repro steps and customer logs.
